name: polycards-handwriting-emnist-letters

output.name: probs
output.note: case-insensitive: upper and lower case of a letter share one label

preprocessing: Start from the letter box drawn as dark ink on a white background
Invert so ink is bright (255 - value)
Find ink pixels (value > 30) and crop to their bounding box; if none, the box is empty
Center the crop in a square of side max(height, width), padded with black
Pad every side by round(side * 2 / 24) pixels of black
Divide by 255, then divide by the maximum pixel so the brightest pixel is 1.0
test_set_reference: Section 6 preprocess_drawing() in the training notebook
